edit.titleRaw: Multi-criteria decision analysis of the value of comprehensive genomic profiling in non-small cell lung cancer
edit.sourceName: PubMed 药物经济学与卫生技术评估
edit.journal: Synthetic Journal of Health Technology Assessment
edit.abstract: Synthetic fixture. Background: Comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is offered unevenly across health systems. Methods: We applied multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) to compare CGP with single-gene testing. A panel of 15 stakeholders (oncologists, pathologists, payers and patient representatives) weighted and scored 9 criteria, including clinical benefit, budget impact, equity of access and turnaround time, on a scale of 0 to 5. Results: CGP obtained a weighted value score of 3.9 against 2.7 for single-gene testing; the ranking was unchanged in scenario analyses that varied the weights by 20%. Conclusions: Stakeholders valued CGP above single-gene testing on the criteria considered.

evidence_type.why: a cost-effectiveness model is a health-economic evaluation: the trials it takes its inputs from are not its design, and neither is an observational one (D-04). The text here is authored

edit.titleRaw: Cost-effectiveness of adding dapagliflozin to standard care in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction: a Markov model
edit.sourceName: PubMed 药物经济学与卫生技术评估
edit.abstract: Synthetic fixture. Objective: To estimate the cost-effectiveness of adding dapagliflozin to standard care for adults with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction from the health-system perspective. Methods: A Markov model with a lifetime horizon and annual cycles was built; transition probabilities, utilities and costs were taken from published trials and national price lists. Results: Compared with standard care, dapagliflozin gained 0.31 quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) at an incremental cost of CNY 12,800, an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio of CNY 41,300 per QALY. In probabilistic sensitivity analysis, dapagliflozin was cost-effective in 78% of simulations at a threshold of three times GDP per capita. Conclusions: Under the model's assumptions, adding dapagliflozin is likely to be cost-effective.

evidence_type.why: a questionnaire survey of practitioners' attitudes follows no patients over time and compares no exposed with unexposed groups: it is neither a cohort nor a case-control study (D-04). The text here is authored

edit.titleRaw: Attitudes of hospital pharmacists toward deprescribing in older adults: a national questionnaire survey
edit.abstract: Synthetic fixture. Objective: To describe hospital pharmacists' attitudes toward deprescribing in older adults and the barriers they report. Methods: An online questionnaire was sent to 2,400 hospital pharmacists in 31 provinces between March and May 2026. Results: 1,126 pharmacists responded (46.9%). Of these, 71% agreed that deprescribing should be part of routine medication review, and 58% named lack of time as the main barrier. Pharmacists with clinical training were more likely to report having recommended deprescribing in the past year. Conclusions: Most responding pharmacists support deprescribing, but time and workflow barriers are common.
